 	case commands.ModeSwitchMsg:
		// Switch operating mode
		logDebug("[MODE] ModeSwitchMsg received: mode=%s, sdk=%v", msg.Mode, a.sdk != nil)
		if a.sdk != nil {
			a.sdk.SetOperatingMode(msg.Mode)
			a.operatingMode = msg.Mode // Update local state for sidepanel
			modeUpper := strings.ToUpper(msg.Mode)
			if modeUpper == "" {
				modeUpper = "OFF"
			}
			a.addNotification("success", fmt.Sprintf("Switched to %s mode", modeUpper))
			logDebug("[MODE] Mode set to: %s", msg.Mode)
			if a.debugScreen != nil {
				a.debugScreen.AddLog(fmt.Sprintf("[MODE] ✓ Switched to %s mode", modeUpper))
			}

			// Add or replace system message showing the mode change
			// If in an active conversation, replaces the last mode message to avoid filling context
			// Otherwise, appends the message
			modeObj := mode.GetBuiltinMode(msg.Mode)
			a.addOrReplaceModeMessage(modeUpper, modeObj)
		}
		return a, nil
